findings.text: index_requires_rebuild re-implements the predicate TelemetryIndex already owns at imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_index.py:941; the literal name_id sentinel now sits in two modules, so a schema change that moves it must be edited in both or the rebuild check silently diverges from the writer's refusal that raises at telemetry_index.py:1151.

the ingest command asks whether any snapshot exists by calling index_placement._snapshot_paths, a private helper it does not own, so the second branch of the rebuild condition couples cli.py to another module's internals instead of to a public predicate.
